name: xtfrm.zoo
title: Order key of a zoo series

origin.description: Return the core data of a zoo series, which is the key used to order it.
origin.details: The order key is the core data, without the index. The series 1, NA, 3 yields 1, NA, 3.

translation.description: Return the values of a zoo series, which are the key used to order it.
translation.details: The order key is the numeric values, without the index. The series 1, NA, 3 yields 1, NA, 3.
translation.example:
import math
import sys

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.zoo_class import aggregate_zoo, ifelse_zoo, is_zoo, median_zoo, quantile_zoo, rev_zoo, xtfrm_zoo, zoo


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
        print("TRUE" if value else "FALSE")
        return
    if is_zoo(value):
        show(value.data)
        show(value.index)
        return
    array = np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")
    print(" ".join("NA" if math.isnan(float(item)) else format(float(item), ".16g") for item in array))

show(xtfrm_zoo(zoo([1, float('nan'), 3], [1, 2, 3])))
